name: note-open
moment: READ: a customer quote is pinned in the quote panel (low gain)
prompt: A small stiff paper index card picked up off a wooden table and flicked open, crisp card rustle, close up

name: block-pick
moment: COMMIT: a claim block is lifted to be dragged (soft)
prompt: A solid hardwood block lifted off a wooden rack, one light hollow wood knock, close up

name: peg-in
moment: COMMIT: a quote sticks into a claim block (soft and lower when one goes back to the tray)
prompt: A small wooden dowel peg pushed firmly into a drilled hole in a wooden block, tight wooden squeak and a short tap

name: block-set
moment: COMMIT: a block lands on the tower (once per level)
prompt: A heavy hardwood block set down firmly on top of another hardwood block, one solid dense wood clack

name: lock
moment: COMMIT: the learner starts the meeting
prompt: A heavy brass latch on a wooden case snapped shut, solid metallic clunk

name: hold
moment: REVEAL right: the hand tests a block, the peg carries it, it stays
prompt: A heavy wooden block pressed down firmly by a flat hand onto a stack of solid hardwood blocks, a deep steady wooden creak and thud, the stack settles and holds

name: pull
moment: REVEAL wrong: the hand drags a block out of the tower
prompt: A wooden block dragged sideways out of a tight stack of wooden blocks, rough wood scraping against wood

name: collapse
moment: REVEAL wrong: everything resting on the pulled block comes down
prompt: A tall stack of wooden blocks toppling over and clattering onto a hardwood table, blocks bouncing and rolling

name: debrief
moment: end: the meeting is over and the debrief slides in
prompt: Several sheets of paper squared by tapping them on a wooden desk, then slid into a card folder
